stem: Which of these best helps the reader visualize the setting?

options.label: F
options.text: From these rooms Paul wandered downstairs again.

options.label: G
options.text: Against the walls were sideboards with great pieces of gold and silver, ewers and urns and branching candelabra, which sprinkled the green marble walls with starlike reflections.

options.label: H
options.text: The dining room beyond was more amusing, because busy servants were already laying the long table.

options.label: J
options.text: This seemed to make the library as strange as the rest of the house, and he passed on to the ballroom at the back.
